scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello! Thank you for helping me. I recently submitted a housing loan application and I'm eager to know the status and details of it. Can you please tell me if my application has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Additionally, what is my interest rate if it has been approved?
dialogue.agent: I've checked on your loan application, and I can see that it has been approved and originated. The loan originated with an interest rate of 6.542%.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know that my application has been approved. An interest rate of 6.542% seems a bit high, but I'm glad to have the loan approved. Can you please tell me what the total costs of this loan are? I'm trying to understand the overall expense of this loan. Also, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan that I should be aware of?
dialogue.agent: costs for your loan are $5,600.44. Regarding the HOEPA status, your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage. Additionally, your loan does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: The total costs of $5,600.44 seem reasonable, but I'd like to understand how that breaks down. However, I don't have any questions about that right now. You mentioned that my loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, which is good to know. Can you please tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Fannie Mae after origination. As for the loan product type, it is a Conventional:First Lien loan.

dialogue.user: So my loan was sold to Fannie Mae, that's good to know. A Conventional:First Lien loan is what I was expecting, so that's consistent with my understanding. Can you please tell me what my debt-to-income ratio is? I'm trying to understand how my financial situation was evaluated as part of the loan application process.
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is less than 20%. This ratio represents the percentage of your monthly debt payments relative to your monthly income, and it's used as part of the credit evaluation process for your loan.

dialogue.user:
A debt-to-income ratio of less than 20% sounds relatively healthy, which is reassuring. I think I have all the information I need now. You've been very helpful and transparent throughout this conversation. I'm satisfied with the interaction and the information you've provided. 

<Satisfied> - I'm satisfied with the interaction because the agent was clear, concise, and provided all the necessary information about my loan application in a professional and courteous manner.
